gaps.name: 冰封宝石
gaps.officialRequirement: Each turn, drawing the second card triggers a friendly unit gaining 2 might until end of turn; Diana's conditional draw counts as a draw.
gaps.codeEvidence: CardBehaviorRegistry FROZEN_GEM_PLAY_EQUIPMENT contains only equipment entry; no second-card-drawn counter and targeted trigger implementation was found.

gaps.name: 狂热粉丝
gaps.officialRequirement: On defense, optional destruction moves one attacker to its base; Diana's duel-start trigger occurs first.
gaps.codeEvidence: CardBehaviorRegistry FERVID_FAN_DEFENSE_TRIGGER_PLAY_UNIT only enters a unit; its fixture explicitly states the defense sacrifice movement trigger is deferred.
